question: Who founded the Abhinav Bharat Society?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Savarkar Brothers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhinav Bharat Society** was founded by **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar** and his brother **Ganesh Damodar Savarkar** in **1904**.
 
• Initially known as **Mitra Mela**, the organization aimed to inspire young Indians through revolutionary ideas.
 
• It was a **secret society** that promoted armed rebellion against the British colonial rule.
 
• The society played a significant role in the Indian independence movement by spreading nationalist sentiment and revolutionary activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar**:

 
 
• Also known as **Veer Savarkar**, he was a prominent Indian independence activist, lawyer, and writer.
 
• He is known for his work in the field of **Hindutva** and his contributions to the nationalist movement.
 
• He was imprisoned in the **Cellular Jail** in Andaman and Nicobar Islands for his revolutionary activities.
 
 
 
• **Ganesh Damodar Savarkar**:
 
 
• Elder brother of Vinayak Damodar Savarkar and a key figure in the revolutionary movement against British rule.
 
• He was deeply involved in the activities of the Abhinav Bharat Society and other revolutionary organizations.
 
 
 
• **Revolutionary Activities**:
 
 
• Abhinav Bharat Society was involved in several revolutionary acts, including the assassination of British officials.
 
• The society inspired many young Indians to take up arms against the British colonial government.
 
 
 
• **Legacy**:
 
 
• The activities and ideas of the Savarkar brothers and the Abhinav Bharat Society had a lasting impact on the Indian independence movement.
 
• They are remembered for their courage, dedication, and contributions to India's struggle for freedom.
